sloka: सामभिर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः प्रणम्य स दशाननः ।संवत्सरसहस्रं तु रुदतो रक्षसो गतम् ।। ७.१६.३५ ॥
transliteration: sāmabhirvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇamya sa daśānanaḥ ।saṁvatsarasahasraṁ tu rudato rakṣaso gatam ।। 7.16.35 ॥

translations.english: Having bowed down with various hymns and praises, the ten-headed Ravana spent a thousand years crying and performing penance.
